overview: Your Commitment: standards for ethics, professionalism, and trust. Acknowledge and digitally sign your commitment to proceed.
learningObjectives: Commit to professional conduct and communication

sections.title: Standards & Promise
sections.content:
Please review the commitments below and initial each one to proceed.

- Align with mission and values
- Follow the sales process
- Act with integrity at all times
- Be open to feedback
- No gossip or negativity
- Maintain a disciplined work ethic
- Take pride in workmanship and communication
